card.name: Words before places and routes
card.fires_on: Small words and adjectives that come right before an expected place or landscape noun, such as path, mountain, center, camp or route. Mostly in outdoor, mountaineering, travel and history prose.

modes.label: Linking word before a path or place
modes.description: A preposition or article that precedes a location noun like footpath or reservation.

modes.label: Descriptor before a landmark
modes.description: An adjective or name that precedes a place, route or camp noun.

modes.label: Local facility
modes.description: A modifier before a recycling center or similar site.
